spec: Zero-edge components are contracted (loops dropped, only the source component retained, parallel edges and original edge ids kept) to a positive-weight graph, and exact contracted distances are lifted back to all original vertices with a first-discovery tree of tight original arcs whose recomputed sums equal the labels; unreachable vertices get infinity
paper_ref: Sec 8.3, Algorithm 8 l.2 and l.6/l.16, Lemma 8.5 (txt l.2145-2185)
